title: LETTER 14: Letter to NABARD — Request for Agricultural Infrastructure Fund

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Address the official request directly to the Chief General Manager of the respective NABARD Regional Office.
Clearly state the nature of the agricultural infrastructure project, total estimated outlay, and intended location.
Highlight the alignment of the project with Agri Infrastructure Fund (AIF) guidelines, emphasizing post-harvest management and community assets.
Detail the financial viability, expected social impact, and benefits accruing to local farming communities.

blocks.content: We request financial assistance under the Agricultural Infrastructure Fund to establish post-harvest management infrastructure.

items: Ensure precise adherence to formal business letter formatting (Sender Address, Date, Recipient Designation, Subject, Salutation, Body, Sign-off) as tested in Descriptive English exams.
Include key technical terms like 'Interest Subvention', 'Credit Guarantee', and 'Post-Harvest Management' to gain higher evaluation marks in banking examinations.
Maintain a professional, objective, and persuasive tone focused on agricultural sustainability and economic viability.
